charts.title: Four-view clinical body chart — vector reconstruction

provenance.artwork: Manually authored cubic Bezier contours and separate named detail paths; no bitmap embedding or automatic contour tracing.
provenance.review: Visual reconstruction from supplied illustrations. Landmark and site positions are illustrative and have not been clinically validated.
provenance.symmetry: Front and back are separately authored. Opposing profiles may reuse mirrored geometry; profile names describe image-facing direction only.
